name: Ojou-sama no Hanbun wa Ren'ai de Dekiteimasu!
original_name: お嬢様の半分は恋愛で出来ています！
source:
The pretty boy Hajime is an agent of a large secret organization, who was asked by the boss one day to do the impossible. His mission was to infiltrate Houshou Girl’s Academy, where only pure maidens are allowed, and to claim the title of the greatest lady: ‘Highness’. Thus, he traded in his weapon for lipstick to become an agent of matchless beauty. What is the purpose of this strange mission?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/05/04/may-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
漂亮男孩阿一是一个大型秘密组织的特工，有一天，他被老板要求去做一件不可能的事情。他的任务是潜入只允许纯洁少女入内的凤兽女学园，并夺取最伟大女子的称号：“殿下”。于是，他用武器换了口红，成为了绝世美女的使者。这个奇怪的任务的目的是什么？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/05/04/may-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
